name: aichivist
description: Clean up your files like an archivist: Claude reads your documents, proposes a filing plan you approve, renames by content, finds duplicates, leaves program data alone and logs every step with undo.

folder.title: Folder to organize
folder.description: Claude can only see and file documents inside this folder, e.g. your home or Documents folder.

excluded.title: Private folder (optional)
excluded.description: A folder inside the one above that Claude must never see, e.g. health records.

rules.title: Filing rules (optional)
rules.description: Your rules file (see templates/RULES.md). Without it, Claude asks where things belong.
